_comment: Zelda collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed zelda-triforce` (lines may be shared with other collections since #24), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_hyrule.py.

readme.title: Zelda
readme.summary: Pokemon of the kingdom of Hyrule (inspired by The Legend of Zelda; original patterns).
looks: each line wears one look: the hero's green tunic and belt with a golden triangle emblem (Falinks, Fomantis, Morpeko); ancient tech, slate with glowing cyan circuits (Kabuto, Omanyte, Solrock); Zora blue scales (Squirtle, Seel, Qwilfish); Goron rock (Phanpy, Hippopotas, Wiglett); Gerudo crimson and gold with turquoise gems (Gothita, Larvesta, Drifloon); Korok bark with a crown of leaves (Hoppip, Tarountula, Snorunt)
the ancient tech, emblem and gems glow in the dark; the eyes keep their own colours
shiny: twilight, the colours turned round the colour wheel
